headline: BANK 🏦 HOLDS Rates at 3.75% but Signals RISE 📈 if ENERGY ⚡ Prices STAY HIGH 🔥
text:
The BANK 🏦 OF 🏛️ ENGLAND has HELD 🛑 interest 💰 rates at their CURRENT 📍 level of exactly 3.75% for the SIXTH 🔢 time in a ROW 🚶‍♂️ but they straight up SIGNALED 📡 that rates are LIKELY 📈 to CLIMB 🧗 if those pesky HIGH 🌡️ energy ⚡ prices just REFUSE 🚫 to chill 😎 and PERSIST 🕰️!! Governor ANDREW 🍆 BAILEY 🧔 Daddy kept EDGING 👐 the markets all morning by warning that VOLATILITY 🌪️ in OIL 🛢️ and GAS ⛽ from the US 🇺🇸 ISRAEL 🇮🇱 war with IRAN 🇮🇷 has totally COOKED 🍳 global energy SUPPLIES 📦 leading to a SHARP 🗡️ spike in petrol ⛽ and diesel prices plus an UPTICK 📊 in INFLATION 💨 that is already making everyone down BAD 😩!!

But ANDREW 🍆 BAILEY 🧔 Daddy made it crystal CLEAR 🔎 that this ENERGY ⚡ price VOLATILITY 🌪️ is now making it WAY 🛣️ more likely that interest rates will have to RISE 📈 sooner rather than later to keep things from getting totally RAILED 💦 by inflation!! The BANK 🏦 also ANNOUNCED 📣 it was SLOWING 🐢 its sales of UK government DEBT 📉 which immediately triggered an EASING 🧘 in the UK's long term BORROWING 💸 costs and gave the bond market a much needed HUG 🤗!! Everyone on the Monetary Policy Committee was basically EDGING 👐 each other for HOURS ⏳ with six members VOTING 🗳️ to HOLD 🛑 rates steady at 3.75% while three including chief economist HUW 💊 PILL wanted to PUMP 📈 them straight up to 4% right then and there!!

ANDREW 🍆 BAILEY 🧔 Daddy later admitted the DIRECT 🎯 impact of these higher ENERGY ⚡ prices is already super CLEAR 🔎 but officials are still trying to FIGURE 🧩 out exactly how far those costs will FEED 🍼 through into the wider economy and cause even more INFLATION 💨 chaos across everything from mortgages 🏠 to weekly shops 🛒!! Other MAJOR 🌟 central banks have already been aggressively RAISING 📈 their own rates to fight back against these same PRICE 💲 pressures with the US 🇺🇸 Federal Reserve dropping its first HIKE 🥾 in three years just yesterday and the European Central Bank having already POUNDED 🥊 rates twice since JUNE 🌞!! The UK's inflation has been stuck above the 2% 🎯 TARGET 🎯 for nearly TWO 🕑 whole years now hitting 3.1% back in AUGUST ☀️ and the BANK 🏦 just revised its forecast saying inflation will hit slightly ABOVE ☝️ 4% at the start of next year while warning the household energy price CAP 🧢 on gas 🔥 and electricity ⚡ bills is now expected to RISE 📈 substantially further!!

On the brighter side the BANK 🏦 did drop some POSITIVE 👍 notes saying the UK economy has been way more RESILIENT 💪 than they originally thought and they even BUMPED 📈 their growth prediction from a measly 0.1% to a healthier 0.4% for the July through September period which left some analysts feeling less down BAD 😩!! They also noted that because the higher ENERGY ⚡ costs have not fully SPILLED 🥛 over into other sectors yet food price inflation is now predicted to land at just 4% by year end which is way BETTER 👍 than their previous scary forecast of 6% to 7%!! Financial markets have already priced in several future rate RISES 📈 next year but ANDREW 🍆 BAILEY 🧔 Daddy stressed the global backdrop remains hugely UNPREDICTABLE 🎲 at the moment and rates will only come DOWN ⬇️ once there is an END 🛑 to the conflict in the Middle East plus energy prices returning all the way back to where they were BEFORE ⏮️ this mess began!!

This whole situation is already hitting borrowers HARD 🥊 like poor Andy Pargeter from Flintshire and his wife who are about to come OFF ⬅️ their sweet five year fixed rate mortgage of only 1.19% in November and now face shelling out around £300 more every single MONTH 📅 even though they were secretly HOPING 🤞 rates might be falling by now!! ANDREW 🍆 BAILEY 🧔 Daddy and the BANK 🏦 also decided to PAUSE ⏸️ their so called quantitative tightening programme meaning they will stop aggressively selling off huge chunks of those government BONDS 🔗 and instead dribble out smaller amounts over the next eight YEARS 🗓️ after having bought a whopping £895 billion during the financial crisis and COVID 🦠 chaos!! The yield on 30 year UK government bonds immediately DROPPED 🪨 from 5.86% down to 5.75% after the announcement while 10 year yields also slipped from 5.31% to 5.22% giving the government a surprise little break on its own borrowing costs!!
